data.name: Momin
data.gender_notes: Momin is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Momin is an Arabic name that signifies a person who has faith and is a true believer in God. It is derived from the Arabic word 'mu'min', meaning 'one who has faith'. The name Momin carries the meaning “Faithful, Believer” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Momin usually hope their child will grow to embody faithful, believer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The Quran encourages believers to be momin, steadfast in their faith, and to trust in Allah's plan.
data.etymology: Momin belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Faithful, Believer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Momin total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_urdu.name: مومن
in_urdu.meaning: ایمان رکھنے والا، صادق القلب، دین دار
